meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

copy.tagline: 设计并运行量子电路，模拟噪声效应
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Google 量子硬件上设计噪声感知电路
copy.tagline_en: Design and run quantum circuits, simulate noise effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design noise-aware circuits for Google quantum hardware

howto.what: Claude会帮你使用Google的Cirq框架设计、模拟和运行量子电路，支持Google Quantum AI硬件等。
howto.when: 当你需要设计噪声感知的量子电路、在Google硬件上运行，或进行量子表征实验时。

say.text: 帮我写一个包含Hadamard和CNOT的Bell态电路。
用模拟器运行该电路1000次，给出结果直方图。
say.note: 执行模拟并统计测量结果。

say.text: 将这个电路提交到Google的Weber处理器运行。
say.note: 需要配置GCP认证和处理器ID。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you design, simulate, and run quantum circuits using Google's Cirq framework, targeting Google Quantum AI hardware and more.
howto.when_en: When you need to design noise-aware quantum circuits, run on Google hardware, or perform quantum characterization experiments.

say_en.text: Write a Bell state circuit with Hadamard and CNOT.
say_en.note: Generate and display the circuit diagram.

say_en.text: Simulate the circuit 1000 times and show the result histogram.
say_en.note: Run simulation and tally measurement outcomes.

say_en.text: Submit this circuit to Google's Weber processor.
say_en.note: Requires GCP credentials and processor ID.
